scientific_integrity: Analytic proof of all-parameter optimization, with independent finite exact-arithmetic checks of examples. Priority checks are not exhaustive; no expert or independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Equal-sized unweighted complete multipartite graphs; finite positive shift; independent Rademacher signs and exactly one supported probe per color; two nonempty classes; variance only. No claim about unequal parts, alternative estimators, or execution time.
title: Parity-rigid optimal two-color probing on balanced complete multipartite resolvents
